artist.name: MURTHOVIC
artist.bio: Murthovic (MSR Murthy) is a Hyderabad DJ, producer, sound practitioner and researcher with close to 20 years in electronic music, and a Magnetic Fields regular. With visual artist Thiruda (Avinash Kumar) he created Elsewhere In India, a transmedia project that joins game engine technology with live performance, set in 2079 with digital avatars of both artists. Their project Jal, Jungle, Zameen debuted at Magnetic Fields Nomads in Khetri, Rajasthan in February 2026: a 60-minute live electronica set with hereditary musicians Gopika, Sawai, Jakir, Dilip and Roshan on kamaycha, morchang, bhapang, khartal and dholak. He has also played audiovisual Bharatnatyam DJ sets in Hyderabad (2023).
